title: Sharp Bounds and Canonical Blow-ups for Toric Projectivization
summary: For every dimension $n\ge3$, we construct a family $Σ_n(a,b)$ of smooth complete fans with Picard number five and fixed combinatorial type. For integers $a,b\ge1$, the minimum number of new rays in a smooth projective refinement is $\min(a,b)$, attained by ordinary invariant codimension-two blow-ups. If projective simplicial refinements with maximal-cone multiplicity at most an integer $μ\ge1$ are allowed, the minimum is $\lceil\min(a,b)/μ\rceil$.
